leadText:
Kent (Japanese: ケント Kent) is a character of the day who appeared in A Cacturne for the Worse. He is a Pokémon Coordinator who competed in the Purika City Pokémon Contest with his .

During the first round, Kent was able to impress the Contest judges enough with his performance. As a result, he was one of the contestants to make it in to the Battle Stage. There, he went up against but lost, therefore being eliminated from the competition.

He reappeared (albeit in photographs only) in A Hurdle for Squirtle and What I Did for Love!, competing in the Saffron City and Gardenia Town Pokémon Contests. In both Contests he made it past the Appeal round, but proceeded to lose in the quarter-finals.
